Reduce bundle size of Framer Motion | Motion for React

name: Reduce bundle size
summary: Motion (Framer Motion) guide to shrinking the React animation bundle with tree shaking, LazyMotion and m components.
description: Guide from the Motion docs on reducing the Motion for React bundle: what each animation feature bundle contains, synchronous vs lazy loading via LazyMotion and the m component, strict mode, and the mini and hybrid useAnimate sizes. The old Framer docs URL now redirects to Framer's design page; the guide itself lives in the Motion documentation.
